verdict.rationale: PostHog's own feature-flag docs say it can ship JSON alongside a flag through remote config, which covers dynamic configuration beyond booleans. The pack never explicitly mentions multivariate (multi-variant string) flags or typed number and string values, so only part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multivariate flag variants, string/number config value types, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Ship JSON alongside a flag with remote config, and share flags across projects.
